dedupe_keys.name: boston citywide 3d model buildings terrain and groundplan

description: The City of Boston Planning Department GIS Lab maintains a 3D model of the city for public download, made of terrain, a groundplan and 3D models of buildings. Each component is offered in open data formats and as an all-in-one SketchUp model per tile, found through an interactive tile map with documentation and a citywide SketchUp tile grid. Analyze Boston also lists the Boston 3D Buildings (Existing) scene layer, the authoritative existing-conditions layer, updated as needed with handmade and procedurally generated models and last updated in September 2026; the city notes it is meant for visualisation. Coverage: the city of Boston. Access: tile downloads from the Planning Department page and the ArcGIS scene layer through Analyze Boston. Licence: PDDL; free. Caveats: building models come from several sources of varying detail, and the scene layer is for visualisation, not analysis. Simulation uses are urban design review, shadow and view studies and a geometric base for city energy or flood models. Related records: other city 3D models such as Helsinki and the NYC building footprints.
